current_scope.purpose: Public minimized event registry for R&D documentation, IPR AI Audit Trail visibility, IPR Base references, IPR Verified public proof references, evidence-pack continuity, registry v3 testing, and technical review.
current_scope.public_position: This registry is a public R&D reference surface. It is not a public authority event registry, not a civil identity registry, not a regulated certification register, not an eIDAS qualified trust service, not a regulated KYC/AML provider, not a custodial identity service, and not a production compliance framework by itself.
current_scope.operational_boundary: Event entries are descriptive public metadata. They do not expose tax codes, fiscal codes, document numbers, identity documents, identity scans, private evidence, raw AI prompts, raw AI outputs, client files, personal data, private keys, production logs, internal endpoints, confidential payloads, or privileged operational access.

IPR_BASE.interpretation: Technical R&D record for proof flows and controlled demonstrations. It does not create verified identity status.

IPR_VERIFIED.interpretation: Private verification profile. Tax-code and valid identity-document evidence may be used only in a controlled private layer. The public event registry stores only minimized proof references.

IPR_PROFESSIONAL.interpretation: Future professional or business/audit workflow profile based on IPR Verified. It remains pilot-positioned and does not create regulated certification by itself.

rules.public_event_interpretation: A public event entry is descriptive R&D registry metadata unless independently supported by a canonical proof record. It does not certify legal identity, regulated KYC/AML compliance, eIDAS qualification, public authority approval, production compliance, cybersecurity assurance, or institutional mandate.
rules.production_interpretation: A public event entry does not certify production readiness, public authority approval, regulated compliance, cybersecurity assurance, legal identity, KYC/AML compliance, or institutional mandate.

privacy_note: This public event registry must not store tax codes, fiscal codes, document numbers, identity documents, identity scans, private evidence, personal data, credentials, secrets, private keys, production logs, private communications, internal endpoints, raw AI prompts, raw AI outputs, client files, regulated identity documents, financial assets, or sensitive operational payloads. Public event records should use minimized metadata and hash-oriented references.
empty_registry_interpretation: An empty events array means no public event records are currently available in this registry file. It does not certify absence of activity, validity, authorization, compliance, security status, identity status, or operational status by itself.

constraints.event_id: Public minimal event identifier only; must not expose secrets, private evidence, internal endpoints, tax codes, document numbers, identity documents, or sensitive operational payloads.
constraints.event_type: IPR_BASE_CREATED | IPR_VERIFIED_PRIVATE_CHECK_RECORDED | IPR_PROFESSIONAL_PILOT_RECORDED | AI_OUTPUT_RECORDED | AI_OUTPUT_REVIEWED | HUMAN_VALIDATION | POLICY_CHECK | RISK_ASSESSMENT | GOVERNANCE_DECISION | AUDIT_NOTE | EVIDENCE_PACK_CREATED | REGISTRY_STATUS_UPDATE | VERIFICATION_REQUEST | VERIFICATION_RESULT | ACCESS_EVENT | SECURITY_NOTICE
constraints.event_payload_sha256: 64-character SHA-256 hexadecimal hash of the private event payload.
constraints.timestamp: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 parseable timestamp with timezone.
constraints.status: RECORDED | SUPERSEDED | REVOKED | INVALID | RND_ONLY | EXPERIMENTAL | PRIVATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED | FAIL_CLOSED

verification.rule: Public event records must be treated as descriptive R&D registry metadata unless independently verified by a canonical proof record.
verification.fail_closed_rule: Missing, malformed, ambiguous, placeholder-based, forbidden-field-based, or inconsistent event registry state must not produce operational certainty.
verification.production_rule: RND_ONLY and EXPERIMENTAL statuses must not be interpreted as regulated certification, public authority approval, production compliance validity, cybersecurity assurance, legal authorization, legal identity, eIDAS qualification, or KYC/AML compliance.

events.description: R&D public event record representing the hash-oriented registration of an AI-assisted output inside the IPR AI Audit Trail self-pilot.
events.note: This event exposes only minimized public metadata and a payload hash. It does not expose the underlying AI output, prompt, review note, client file, or private evidence.

events.description: R&D public event record representing a policy-check step in the IPR AI Audit Trail self-pilot.
events.note: This event is descriptive R&D metadata only. It is not a regulated compliance certification.

events.description: R&D public event record representing human validation of an AI audit-trail record.
events.note: The event records that a validation step exists as hash-oriented metadata. It does not expose the private validation payload.

events.description: R&D public event record representing the creation of a hash-oriented evidence-pack reference for IPR AI Audit Trail.
events.note: The underlying evidence pack is not stored in this public registry file.

events.description: R&D public event record representing a fail-closed verification result for the IPR AI Audit Trail self-pilot.
events.note: A verification result in RND_ONLY mode is not production compliance certification, public authority approval, regulated assurance, legal identity validation, eIDAS qualification, or KYC/AML compliance.
